THE STARTING POINT

Work does not always happen at a desk.

A mobile experience has different constraints: smaller screens, interruptions, network changes, and real-world tasks. We design around those conditions from the beginning.

IMPLEMENTATION CONSIDERATIONS

Decisions that
shape delivery.

01Platforms & devices
Confirm iOS, Android, supported devices, required native features, and accessibility expectations before selecting a development approach.
02Connectivity & data
Define which tasks require a connection, how pending updates behave, and how conflicts or failures are presented to the user.
03Release & maintenance
Agree store-account ownership, review responsibilities, distribution, supported versions, and the process for future operating-system updates.

QUESTIONS & ANSWERS

Before your mobile development project.

Clear answers help define the right next step. Your project scope and responsibilities are agreed before delivery.

Ask the team

Both platforms can be considered. The choice of shared or platform-specific implementation depends on the features, user experience, device needs, and maintenance requirements.

Offline behavior can be scoped for selected tasks. Local storage, synchronization, conflict handling, and data access require explicit design and validation.

We review the available APIs, authentication, data contracts, and performance expectations. Any required backend changes are identified during planning.

Release guidance or submission support can be included in the agreed scope. Store accounts, required information, approvals, and ongoing ownership remain clearly assigned.

Compatibility checks and ongoing maintenance can be covered by a support engagement. Supported versions and update responsibilities are agreed before release.
